reuse.why: The change reuses tag extraction, month utilities, spreadsheet access, budget writes, batching, and undo wrappers already present in the tree.

duplication.why: Five actions repeat category-selection queries and eligibility checks, while copyPreviousMonth expresses the same policy separately.

placement.why: Budget policy remains in budget/actions.ts and method registration follows the existing budget/app.ts layering.

scope.why: All edits concern the requested month-wide actions, their registration, and associated tests.

maintainability.why: Sharing only tag recognition and a visibility SQL fragment leaves the overall eligibility policy scattered across six actions.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The original tree has no shared month-wide eligibility abstraction, and the change uses its existing utility and mutation abstractions.

disguised_duplication.where: copyPreviousMonth implements template and visibility exclusions as JavaScript guards, duplicating the policy expressed through SQL predicates in the other month-wide actions.

abstraction_drift.where: visibleCategoriesFilter introduces an includeHiddenCategories parameter and conditional SQL branch, but copyPreviousMonth retains its own visibility decision outside that shared helper.
